verdict.rationale: Babylon.js publishes a dedicated llms.txt at both doc.babylonjs.com/llms.txt and www.babylonjs.com/llms.txt, confirmed live via a direct HTTP 200 probe, containing structured feature/doc summaries clearly intended for LLM/agent consumption. This is exactly the artifact an AI-native user would point an agent at. Missing for 10: no independent report of an agent actually consuming/using the file successfully, and no broader agent-specific docs (e.g., MCP server or agent guide) beyond the llms.txt file itself.
